# Ring & Respond — Sunny

> Sunny by Ring & Respond is an AI receptionist for dental offices. She answers the calls the front desk can't get to — overflow, lunch, and after hours — in the practice's own name. Slogan: "Answered with a smile." Updated November 2026.

## In one sentence
Sunny turns every missed call into a name, a number, and a next step — sorted before you open.

## Contact
- Hear Sunny live (public demo line): (619) 202-1085
- Email: hello@ringandrespond.com
- Website: https://ringandrespond.com/
- Office dashboard (in build): app.ringandrespond.com

## The problem (one published statistic)
- In Patient Prism's 2025 analysis of 11.5 million dental calls (8,280 locations), 31 of every 100 callers hung up before reaching anyone. (Vendor platform data, cited as such.)

## Live today
- Answers in the practice's name — after-hours and 24/7 overflow.
- Capture-it-right intake: caller name, callback number read back digit-by-digit, new/existing patient, preferred callback window.
- 3-tier urgency sort: true emergencies directed to 911/urgent care, with an instant team alert; urgents sit at the top of the list.
- Never-a-voicemail nights: a real conversation, with honest AI and recording disclosure.
- Full conversations in English, Spanish, Arabic, and Farsi.
- Insurance-question capture: carrier plus the caller's exact question, word for word, for the team to answer. Capture only — this is not insurance verification.
- One morning callback list, urgencies first, ready before the office opens.
- Owner proof report: the week's calls, requests, and urgency mix.
- The same Sunny at every location.
- Honest boundary: Sunny does not book into the practice's schedule today and never touches the patient database. The team calls back — in control.

## Coming (labeled coming, gate named)
- Missed-call text-back — coming (carrier texting approval; resubmission Nov 13).
- Appointment confirmations and same-day backfill of cancelled slots — coming (rides texting + schedule read).
- Recall and reactivation runs on the office's own list — coming.
- Review requests by text — coming (a QR version works today).
- Booking into Open Dental — coming (developer access in progress; nothing is booked by Sunny until this is live and proven).
- Insurance eligibility verification — in the sandbox today; production comes with a signed pilot office.
- Patient billing portal (patients pay the office directly) — coming, later phase.
- Caller recognition and intent — coming, phased: Phase 1 (with the office dashboard) labels every call by intent (book / reschedule / billing / insurance / emergency) from the conversation itself and recognizes repeat callers from Sunny's own call history. Phase 2 (with the Open Dental connection) adds full patient match — a caller card with name, next appointment, and pending treatment. Neither phase is live today; Sunny does not match patient records today.

## Option — office-controlled
- Warm transfer to the on-call dentist: NOT AVAILABLE YET — a spec item until the transfer path is built and tested end-to-end. When it ships, it is an office-controlled ON/OFF option: ON = a true emergency can be connected live to the on-call dentist. OFF = Sunny captures the details, flags it urgent, and alerts the team instead.

## Pricing
- After-Hours Capture — $199/mo.
- 24/7 Complete — $299/mo.
- $0 setup. Generous minutes included — past them, a small overage of $0.25/min. Month-to-month.
- Included minutes: After-Hours Capture 250/mo · 24/7 Complete 400/mo.
- Paid 30-day pilot: first month up front, unconditional money-back guarantee — email hello@ringandrespond.com within 30 days.
- Go-live in days, not weeks. Switching = keep your number, turn on forwarding (overflow + after-hours), change your mind by turning forwarding off.
- Your patients' information is protected: a signed Business Associate Agreement (BAA) is in place before any patient information flows to Sunny.
